messages:
maya: Heads-up — after the metadata reshape last night some console dashboards are returning empty series for certain routes. looks like cohort->shard mapping changed and the analytics readmodel wasn't picking it up.

arjun: Can you paste an example query + route id?

maya: repro: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM console_events WHERE cohort_id = 'cohort-17' AND time > now() - interval '7 days'; returns 0 but raw ingest shows data.

beatrice: I think this is the route_key -> cohort_id rename + shard_line partitioning. the legacy projector still reads route_id and falls back incorrectly.

sam: This could affect quota dashboards too (p99 spike looks like missing tenancy). we should avoid a full backfill during peak.

lucy: Proposal: dualwrite ingest for 48h + shadow-read canary on 5 largest tenants. do lightweight backfill for cohorts with mismatch.

maya: +1. what's the exact dualwrite flag?

beatrice: feature flag: ingest.dualwrite.cohort_shard_reconcile = true. it writes both cohort_id and legacy_route_id into envelope. also emit telemetry.event('cohort_dualwrite', {tenant, cohort_id}).

arjun: For shadow reads we can add a read-adapter that attempts new shard_line lookup then fallback to legacy. patch on console-read with header X-Read-Mode: shadow.

ingest-bot: deploy failed in canary yesterday due to index bloat on compact_telemetry. Recommend testing index build on copy cluster.

sam: OK can we instead do phased index build off-hours and use concurrent index? e.g.```\nCREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON console_events (cohort_id) WHERE time >= now() - interval '30 days';\n```That limits IO.

lucy: For rollouts: 1) enable dualwrite on ingest for 48h (all regions) 2) deploy shadow-read adapter to console (canary tenants) 3) build index concurrently on staging copy, then prod off-hours 4) run reconciliation job that emits diff metrics and retries missing writes 5) small backfill for cohorts with gaps 6) flip read-mode to new by tenant.

maya: Does reconciliation job already exist or do we need a new one?

beatrice: We'll need a new one. simple idea: scan last 7 days, join legacy route index to new shard_line and count mismatches, emit to telemetry. pseudocode:```\n-- pseudocode\nSELECT tenant, cohort_id, count(*) as missing\nFROM raw_ingest r\nLEFT JOIN console_events c ON r.envelope_id = c.envelope_id\nWHERE c.cohort_id IS NULL\nGROUP BY tenant, cohort_id;\n```Then backfill by streaming matching envelopes into projection pipeline.

arjun: Also confirm quota calculation service uses route_key vs route_id. if quota service uses old field we'll need a compatibility layer for 1 week.

sam: I can add a shim in quota-router: if cohort_id missing, compute shard_line via legacy map and memoize for 24h. reduces query load.

lucy: UX note: product wants dashboard to show a 'migration' badge for affected routes and a link to migration timeline. avoid confusing customers.

maya: Who owns the reconciliation job? beatrice? arjun?

beatrice: I'll own the job + telemetry. arjun will own the read-adapter. sam owns quota shim + index ops. lucy will coordinate canary tenants + product messaging.

maya: timeline?

beatrice: Draft timeline: today - enable dualwrite in staging; +24h - sanity checks & shadow reads canary; +48-72h - concurrent index prod during low traffic; +72-120h - reconciliation + small backfills; +7d - flip reads for non-canary tenants.

arjun: I'll open a PR for the read-adapter + tests. tag me for review.

sam: I'll schedule index window tomorrow 02:00 UTC and put rollback notes in runbook.

lucy: I'll draft customer-facing banner and canary list.

maya: Great. Add alerts for telemetry: cohort_dualwrite_mismatch_rate > 0.5% and console_query_empties increase.

beatrice: noted. creating tracking ticket and will post deploy checklist once PRs are up. :shipit:
